footer.desc: Transforming coffee waste into sustainable values for modern living. Each product is a promise to our green planet. Join us in our journey to redesign the coffee industry through a circular lens.
home.heroDesc: We redefine the value of coffee grounds, transforming what seems like waste into exquisite, eco-friendly products for modern living.
home.storyHeading: Every cup of coffee in Vietnam leaves a massive amount of waste.
home.storyDesc: RE:CAFÉ was born with the mission to collect this valuable resource from strategic partners like Deer Coffee, Betea, etc., applying advanced processing technology to create sustainable biomaterials.
home.cleanMaterialDesc: Closed collection and processing cycle ensures the purest quality.
home.upcyclingTechDesc: Elevating coffee grounds into premium housewares and decorations.
home.statsHeading: Numbers are not just statistics, they are our commitment to the green planet.
home.statsDesc: Every small step by RE:CAFÉ directly contributes to the goal of reducing plastic and carbon waste in the service industry.
home.partnerDesc: We are proud to accompany leading coffee brands to realize the circular economy vision, bringing recycled coffee grounds back to serve customers.
products.title: Curated Sustainability
products.desc: Discover our premium range of lifestyle products handcrafted from repurposed coffee grounds. Waste transformed into artisanal worth.
products.noProducts: No products found matching your filters.
products.everyPurchaseDesc: We partner directly with Highlands Coffee farmers to ensure 100% of the grounds from their flagship stores are diverted from landfills and turned into the products you see here.
products.circularDesc: Read our 2024 Sustainability Report to see how RE:CAFÉ is closing the loop on coffee waste in Vietnam.
detail.warning: NOTE: The product is for display purposes only, do not use to contain food.
detail.storyHeading: The journey of regenerating original coffee beans into sustainable art pieces.
detail.originDesc: Coffee grounds are collected from stores nationwide, ensuring clean and abundant resources, initiating the circular journey.
detail.processDesc: The process of drying, fine grinding, and mixing with biodegradable bioplastics reduces carbon emissions by 80% compared to traditional ceramics.
detail.compositionTag: Percentage of pure coffee grounds in each RE:CAFÉ product, retaining its natural aroma and signature rustic texture.
detail.handmadeTag: Each product is meticulously handcrafted to create a unique surface texture and the most durable quality for modern living spaces.

impact.heroTitle: Turning Every Bean Into a Better Future.
impact.heroDesc: We've transformed the circular economy into an art form. By repurposing spent coffee grounds from Highland partners, we reduce methane emissions and create premium lifestyle objects.
impact.floatingTag: Upcycled materials used in our core collection.
impact.metricRecycledDesc: Equivalent to saving 4,500kg of CO2 emissions from landfills.
impact.metricItemsDesc: Handcrafted decor and lifestyle pieces sold worldwide.
impact.metricPartnersDesc: Highland coffee shops contributing their daily waste to our cause.
impact.step1Desc: Daily pick-ups from our certified partners ensure no bean goes to waste. Grounds are sorted and prepared under strict quality guidelines.
impact.step2Desc: Our proprietary bio-binder turns coffee grounds into a durable, heat-resistant composite, without using any toxic synthetic resins.
impact.step3Desc: Merging high-end circularity with minimalist aesthetics. We design items that tell the story of the coffee seed's rebirth in a modern home.
impact.lifecycleDesc: At the end of their long life, RE:CAFÉ products are designed to be crushed and returned to the earth as a nutrient-rich soil amendment. Truly zero waste.
impact.partnerTitle: Every bean we collect starts at your favorite local coffee shop.
impact.partnerSub: Visit our partners and see the impact in person.
